external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Instituto Statale di Instruzione Supereriore “Il Pontormo” w Empoli – Italy

At the end of November 2025, the management team and teachers of Kolegium Europejskie took part in an Erasmus+ educational mobility in France. Our host institution was Lycée-Collège Grand Air in La Baule-Escoublac – a prestigious school located in an elegant seaside resort on the Atlantic coast, surrounded by greenery and a calm environment conducive to learning and reflection.

Our school provides the opportunity to study unique subjects within the IB DP curriculum, allowing students to stand out in university applications. Graduates from Kolegium Europejskie have been accepted into prestigious institutions such as Harvard, Yale, MIT, Cambridge, and Oxford.
